title: Odile and the Winter
author: Yara Pemberton
blurb: Felix Montrose, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
